final: SELECT e.EmployeeId AS SupportRepId, e.City AS EmployeeCity, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount, COUNT(c.CustomerId) * 1.0 / AVG(COUNT(c.CustomerId)) OVER (PARTITION BY e.City) AS CityAverageRatio, COUNT(c.CustomerId) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(c.CustomerId)) OVER () AS OverallTotalRatio FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City ORDER BY OverallTotalRatio DESC LIMIT 10
